title: Retro TV Emulator Will Need Testers Soon.
author: RetroTVEmulator
selftext: This is my Homemade Retro TV Emulator. I painted my own images using Sketchbook Pro and upscaling tools. I used tools that made the background transparent for my bezels/logos after making them. I used Google AI to ask coding questions to help me learn how all this should work. Logo images were examples from google, that were repainted and upsaled bc the source images were unusable (designs mostly stayed the same just cleaned up). I created a splash screen video using one of my repainted logos and NightCafe AI image to video tool (this is not in the project, used with a splash screen option you can add video to). If i used AI anywhere i will tell you about it. The code is me figuring what i need, where i need it, and inserting it and testing it. Yes i asked questions about what i needed, where it needed to be, and how it all worked. I used Google AI to learn these things. I like painting so i do all that myself but you still need tools to make the background transparent or upscale images so they look crisp in 4k. (explaining all of this bc ppl seem to have an issue with my project bc it looks to good and must be 100% AI, those ppl plz leave my post along with your drama) Full discloser i have ran my whole project through claude and asked it to evaluate my best practices and stability of the code. It pointed out some gaps that i then fixed myself using information from google AI (bc its free with no limits and i learn along the way) I am finishing up some options for the games, fine tuning some things, looking for bugs to fix. Very soon i will need testers. To watch tv, listen to music, play video games and tell me if it crashes at any point, freezing, any bugs, navigation issues, games that dont launch, controllers that dont work, anything i can find out to make improvements with. Wanna build a community that can help me work out the bugs so we can release it to the public. Any and all help appreciated. For access to the build, join our discord and let us know what you wanna help with. [https://discord.gg/YW4R4sdjr](https://discord.gg/YW4R4sdjr) (it is open source, no Github until i figure out why its not working, source code available with test build on google drive, link in discord) This app is for Windows and we will test it on Proton on Linux. Im gonna add support for it to run on proton vs rebuilding it for Linux and probably wont for MacOS unless we find a Proton equivalent (i havent looked yet).
